limitations: All four new runs ended before iteration 299; no scheduled checkpoint at 299/300/599/600 was reached. No measured same-iterate residual gap or Arnoldi-orthogonality causal proof.

Old33998 remains interrupted NONPASS, not a normal benchmark. Historical AUD5774 embeds partial resource observations; the original summary is not currently present. Its saved x passing an independent residual gate does not upgrade its original outer status.

The three normal old/new pairs have matching own-A and literal-seed evidence; new8439 has pinned own-A/TrainingBank/generator evidence, not a replay of individual saved seed bytes. Actual old33998 KSP view is not restored.

Times are single observed supervised executions, including setup, qualification, logging and cleanup. Setup is a subset, not additive. Neither elapsed minus setup nor these totals is an isolated solve/orthogonalization cost.

Displayed outer-process times exclude original FE assembly, separate saved-x audits, separate physics, earlier failed/search runs, runtime restoration, backup and developer time; not total project cost.
All four new roots retain ALGEBRAIC_PASS_PENDING_PHYSICS. Same-A old/new iterative-vector differences are not direct-solution errors or new physical certification.
Fixed p6 and these finite meshes/mode sets only: no h independence, k robustness, mesh convergence, full-scale or infinite-tail/truncation-sufficiency theorem. PML work remains paused.
This is an archive-only closeout. No numerical run, runtime restoration or large matrix/field revalidation was performed on 2026-10-30.
No fair end-to-end direct-versus-iterative timing comparison is available: same A, hardware/threads, accuracy, assembly/factor/solve and reuse amortization would all need matching.

Source/manifest identities and Library catalog references do not constitute a standalone runnable GitHub reproduction package. The environment, numerical source closure and large private artifacts must be restored and qualified separately.
The 0.56 nm case is assembled, not solved; conditional PC sources and any unexecuted enrichment proposal are not numerical results.
